assignment_rule: Assign when the report defines foundational VR concepts, taxonomies, historical structure, or field-level method organization
Assign for display systems, rendering, foveation, visual quality, or graphics-performance evidence
Assign for pose/eye/body/environment sensing, tracking algorithms, calibration, or sensing accuracy
Assign for input modalities, selection/manipulation, hands-free/hand/controller interaction, or interaction performance
Assign for virtual locomotion, navigation, redirected walking, gains, resets, steering, or locomotion evaluation
Assign for tactile/force/haptic sensing or feedback and its evaluation
Assign for spatial audio or explicitly multisensory integration beyond haptics alone
Assign for presence, embodiment, ownership, agency, or related validated constructs
Assign for cybersickness, simulator sickness, discomfort, fatigue, or tolerance
Assign for avatar appearance, realism, customization, identity, animation, or virtual-human representation
Assign for AI-driven/embodied agents, LLM interaction, intelligent behavior, or adaptive AI components in VR
Assign for collaborative/social/multiuser VR, co-presence, interpersonal interaction, or shared virtual environments
Assign for VR streaming, networking, edge/cloud delivery, latency/QoE infrastructure, or distributed execution
Assign for VR privacy, security, biometric/authentication, threat models, or defenses
Assign for disability access, inclusive interaction, accessibility barriers, or assistive VR design
Assign for evaluation methodology, measurement instruments, statistical/reporting practice, or methodological quality
Assign for reusable software/toolkits/datasets, experiment infrastructure, code/data availability, or reproducibility
Assign for clinical, rehabilitation, health-professional, patient, or health-science VR evidence
Assign for learning, instruction, training, transfer, assessment, or educational VR
Assign for manufacturing, engineering operations, industrial VR, digital twins, maintenance, or related enterprise application
Assign when the report directly informs cross-study comparability, contradiction, reproducibility, evidence quality, or gap-validation methodology
